# Fallout 76: Mojave Bundle (Community Name: NCR Bundle) [Xbox Offer]

![Fallout 76: Mojave Bundle (Community Name: NCR Bundle) \[Xbox Offer\]](/uploads/635_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

[Update June 11, 2026] New Xbox offer

There has been a new cosmetic bundle for Fallout 76 since January 29th, 2026. The items are based on the Prime series and already appeared in the data mining post and video from December 18th, 2025. Now the appropriate bundle is available, which the community has been expecting since data mining as the “NCR Bundle”. Even including the first 4 star Atom Shop weapon with the new 4 star mod "Charged", which is also available in the raid. (See video below.)

## Contents of the Mojave Bundle

Grab your NCR power armor and patrol the Burning Springs desert with the Mojave Pack:

- 
**Power Armor Paint (Ranger)**
*Also known as "NCR Ranger Power Armor".*
- 
**NCR Flag**
- 
**New Vegas Neon Sign**
- 
**Superhammer (Ad victoriam)**
 - 4 Star Legendary Mods:
 - Raging
 - Quickly
 - Strength
 - Charged
- 4 Star Legendary Mods:
- 
**Envoy of the Legion Outfit**
- 
**Player title prefix “Ad victoriam”**
- 
**Player Title Prefix & Suffix – “Tribun:in”**

## Offers

Xbox: €14.99 (until June 17th) €29.99 on offer

Playstation: €29.99 on offer

PC Steam: €29.99 on offer
